name: Invaders of Alterac Valley
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Listen up, adventurer.  No matter what you might have heard about the battle raging in Alterac Valley, one thing remains true: the Stormpike Expedition invaded Frostwolf Territory.  The day we allow the Alliance to invade Horde lands without a forceful response is the day I hang up my axe and live the rest of my life in shame.  Go forth and expel the invaders!
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
narrative.offerRewardText: You've shown great bravery in protecting our lands in Alterac Valley! I will tell my superiors of your deeds.
narrative.requestItemsText: What news do you bring from the lands of the Frostwolves? How does the battle for Alterac Valley fare?
